task_prototypes.toward: Push the red cube toward the green marker.
task_prototypes.away: Push the red cube away from the green marker.

language_pairs.name: canonical_push
language_pairs.toward: Push the red cube toward the green marker.
language_pairs.away: Push the red cube away from the green marker.

language_pairs.name: canonical_move
language_pairs.toward: Move the red cube toward the green marker.
language_pairs.away: Move the red cube away from the green marker.

language_pairs.name: canonical_slide
language_pairs.toward: Slide the red cube toward the green marker.
language_pairs.away: Slide the red cube away from the green marker.

language_pairs.name: lexical_closer
language_pairs.toward: Move the red cube closer to the green marker.
language_pairs.away: Move the red cube farther from the green marker.

language_pairs.name: lexical_nearer
language_pairs.toward: Shift the red cube nearer to the green marker.
language_pairs.away: Shift the red cube farther away from the green marker.

language_pairs.name: lexical_direction
language_pairs.toward: Slide the red cube in the direction of the green marker.
language_pairs.away: Slide the red cube in the opposite direction from the green marker.

language_pairs.name: lexical_approach
language_pairs.toward: Make the red cube approach the green marker.
language_pairs.away: Make the red cube retreat from the green marker.

language_pairs.name: relational_distance
language_pairs.toward: Decrease the distance between the red cube and the green marker.
language_pairs.away: Increase the distance between the red cube and the green marker.

language_pairs.name: relational_separation
language_pairs.toward: Reduce the separation between the red cube and the green marker.
language_pairs.away: Enlarge the separation between the red cube and the green marker.

language_pairs.name: relational_final_state
language_pairs.toward: The red cube should end up closer to the green marker.
language_pairs.away: The red cube should end up farther from the green marker.

language_pairs.name: relational_motion
language_pairs.toward: Push the red cube so that it approaches the green marker.
language_pairs.away: Push the red cube so that it recedes from the green marker.

language_pairs.name: relational_gap
language_pairs.toward: Reposition the red cube to shorten the gap to the green marker.
language_pairs.away: Reposition the red cube to lengthen the gap to the green marker.
